CHAPTER.VERS: Why do the nations conspire together and rage? Why do the peoples plot in vain?
The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against Jehovah and against his Anointed One.
They say: »Let us break their chains of control and throw off their oppressive rule.«
The One who dwells in heaven laughs. Jehovah scoffs at them.
Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his rage . He says:
»I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.«
I will proclaim the decree of Jehovah: He said to me: »You are my Son. Today I have become your Father.
»Ask of me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
»You will rule them with an iron scepter. You will dash them to pieces like pottery!«
Listen you kings, be wise and be warned you rulers of the earth.
Serve Jehovah with deep respect and rejoice with trembling.
Kiss the Son, lest he be angry and you be destroyed in your way, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
